# cook-docs

> Rust CLI for automatically generating standardized Markdown documentation from Cooklang (`.cook`) recipes using Go-compatible templates (`gtmpl-ng`).

`cook-docs` recursively scans directories (respecting `.cookdocsignore`), parses `.cook` recipes with `cooklang`, resolves optional `.jpg`/`.png` recipe images, and renders Markdown documentation (in-place or mirrored into `--output-dir`) using built-in or custom `recipe.md.gotmpl` templates, with `--dry-run` and `--jsonify` modes.

---

## Overview & Mode of Operation

Inspired by `helm-docs`, `cook-docs` automates generating clean, standardized Markdown documentation from [Cooklang](https://cooklang.org/) (`.cook`) recipe collections for static site generators (such as MkDocs Material / Zensical, Hugo, or Jekyll).

- **Recursive Discovery:** Crawls `recipe_search_root` (default `.`) for `*.cook` files while excluding `.git` and paths matched by `.cookdocsignore`.
- **Parallel Rendering:** In normal mode, spawns a thread per discovered recipe; in `--dry-run` mode, renders serially to `stdout`.
- **Slugified Outputs:** Converts `<Recipe Name>.cook` into `<recipe-name>.md` (lowercase with spaces replaced by `-`).
- **Image Detection:** Checks for matching `<Recipe Name>.jpg` first, then `<Recipe Name>.png` in the recipe directory.
- **JSON Export:** With `--jsonify`, serializes the parsed `Recipe` struct (steps, metadata, config, info) as pretty-printed JSON.

---

## Architecture & Repository Layout

### Directory Structure

```text
cook-docs/
├── Cargo.toml                 # Crate manifest (Edition 2024, v0.9.1)
├── Taskfile.yaml              # Task runner definitions
├── pyproject.toml             # Zensical docs Python env (uv)
├── zensical.toml              # Static documentation site config
├── AGENTS.md                  # Agentic rules, architecture, and quality gates
├── .cookdocsignore            # Default ignore patterns
├── .github/workflows/
│   ├── ci.yaml                # Test matrix, rustfmt, clippy, docs, yamllint, typos
│   └── release.yaml           # Multi-arch release builds & draft GitHub release
├── docs/                      # Zensical documentation pages
├── src/
│   ├── main.rs                # CLI entrypoint, logger init, serial/threaded dispatch
│   ├── lib.rs                 # Public library modules
│   ├── config.rs              # Precedence config loader (defaults < YAML < env < CLI)
│   ├── cook.rs                # Discovery, .cookdocsignore, path resolution, Cooklang parse
│   ├── document.rs            # gtmpl-ng templates, custom funcs, formatting, file write
│   └── types.rs               # Serde data models (Config, Recipe, Info, Step, ...)
└── tests/
    └── integration_tests.rs   # Unit & integration tests
```

### Technology Stack

- **Language & Edition:** Rust (Edition 2024)
- **CLI & Config:** `clap` `4.6.1` (`derive`, `env`), `figment` `0.10.19` (`toml`, `yaml`, `env`)
- **Cooklang & Templates:** `cooklang` `0.18.7`, `gtmpl-ng` `0.7.7`
- **Serialization:** `serde` `1.0.228`, `serde_json` `1.0.150`
- **Traversal & Logging:** `ignore` `0.4.26`, `walkdir` `2.5.0`, `log` `0.4.32`, `env_logger` `0.11.10`
- **Docs Site:** Python `>=3.12`, `zensical` `>=0.0.45` managed via `uv`

## Installation & Building

### Package Managers

```bash
# Homebrew
brew install nicholaswilde/tap/cook-docs

# Scoop (Windows)
scoop bucket add nicholaswilde https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install nicholaswilde/cook-docs
```

### Build from Source (Cargo)

```bash
cargo build --release
# Binary written to target/release/cook-docs
```

### Release Targets (CI / `cross`)

- Linux: `x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl`, `armv7-unknown-linux-musleabihf`, `arm-unknown-linux-gnueabihf`
- macOS: `x86_64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-apple-darwin`
- Windows: `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc`

## CLI Options, Config Files & Environment Variables

Configuration resolves in ascending precedence: **built-in defaults < YAML config file < `COOK_DOCS_*` environment variables < CLI flags**.

### Supported Parameters

| CLI Flag | Env Var | YAML Key(s) | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-d, --dry-run` | `COOK_DOCS_DRY_RUN` | `dryRun` / `dry-run` / `dry_run` | `false` | Print rendered Markdown to `stdout` without writing files |
| `-j, --jsonify` | `COOK_DOCS_JSONIFY` | `jsonify` | `false` | Serialize parsed recipe to pretty JSON (logged via `info`) |
| `-i, --ignore-file <FILE>` | `COOK_DOCS_IGNORE_FILE` | `ignoreFile` / `ignore-file` / `ignore_file` | `.cookdocsignore` | Ignore file name for excluding recipe directories/files |
| `-c, --recipe-search-root <DIR>` | `COOK_DOCS_RECIPE_SEARCH_ROOT` | `recipeSearchRoot` / `recipe-search-root` / `recipe_search_root` | `.` | Root directory to recursively scan for `.cook` files |
| `-l, --log-level <LEVEL>` | `COOK_DOCS_LOG_LEVEL` | `logLevel` / `log-level` / `log_level` | `info` | Log filter (`trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`/`warning`, `error`) |
| `-t, --template-files <LIST>` | `COOK_DOCS_TEMPLATE_FILES` | `templateFiles` / `template-files` / `template_files` | `["recipe.md.gotmpl"]` | Comma-separated (CLI/env) or list (YAML) of template paths |
| `-w, --word-wrap <INT>` | `COOK_DOCS_WORD_WRAP` | `wordWrap` / `word-wrap` / `word_wrap` | `120` | Word-wrap line width for step directions |
| `-o, --output-dir <DIR>` | `COOK_DOCS_OUTPUT_DIR` | `outputDir` / `output-dir` / `output_dir` | `""` | Custom output root mirroring relative subdirectories |
| `-v, --version` | — | — | — | Print `cook-docs` version |
| `-h, --help` | — | — | — | Print CLI help |

### Config File Discovery Order

`load_config` selects the first existing file from:

1. `/etc/cook-docs/.cookdocs.yaml`
2. `/etc/cook-docs/.cookdocs.yml`
3. `$HOME/.config/.cookdocs.yaml`
4. `$HOME/.config/.cookdocs.yml`
5. `./.cookdocs.yaml`
6. `./.cookdocs.yml`

Example `.cookdocs.yaml`:

```yaml
dryRun: false
ignoreFile: .cookdocsignore
jsonify: false
logLevel: info
recipeSearchRoot: .
templateFiles:
  - recipe.md.gotmpl
wordWrap: 120
outputDir: ""
```

---

## Ignore Rules & Output Directory Mapping

### `.cookdocsignore`

Uses gitignore-style matching (`ignore::gitignore::GitignoreBuilder`) anchored at the git repository root (or `.` if outside a git repo). Supports directory exclusions and individual `<Recipe Name>.cook` exclusions. `.git` is always skipped.

### Output Path Resolution

- When `output_dir` is empty (`""`): `<recipe_dir>/<slugified-recipe-name>.md`.
- When `output_dir` is set: strips `recipe_search_root` prefix from the canonical recipe path and writes `<output_dir>/<relative_dir>/<slugified-recipe-name>.md` (creating parent directories automatically).

### Quick Usage Examples

```bash
# Render all recipes under current directory
cook-docs

# Preview generated Markdown in stdout for testdata
cook-docs --recipe-search-root testdata --dry-run

# Output into docs/recipes with custom wrap width and debug logs
cook-docs -c recipes -o docs/recipes -w 80 -l debug
```

---

## Templating System (`gtmpl-ng`)

Templates are evaluated using Go `text/template` syntax via `gtmpl-ng`.

### Template Resolution Rules

For each entry in `template_files`:

- **Relative path with directory** (starts with `.` and contains path separators, e.g. `./_templates.gotmpl`): resolved relative to `recipe_search_root`.
- **Base filename only** (e.g. `recipe.md.gotmpl`): resolved relative to each recipe's own directory.
- **Otherwise**: treated as a direct path.

If any requested template file is missing or `template_files` / combined content is empty, `DEFAULT_DOCUMENTATION_TEMPLATE` is appended/used:

```gotmpl
{{ template "cook.headerSection" . }}

{{ template "cook.lazyImageSection" . }}

{{ template "cook.tableSection" . }}

{{ template "cook.ingredientsSection" . }}

{{ template "cook.cookwareSection" . }}

{{ template "cook.stepsSection" . -}}

{{ template "cook.sourceSection" . }}
```

### Built-in Named Templates

**Sections:**
- `cook.headerSection`: `# {{ .Info.RecipeName }}`
- `cook.imageSection`: Markdown image pointing to `../assets/images/<lowercase-dashed-image>`
- `cook.lazyImageSection`: Same image with `{ loading=lazy }` attribute (for `attr_list`)
- `cook.tableSection`: Servings (`Metadata.servings` or `Metadata.serves`) + `sumTimers .Steps` table
- `cook.ingredientsSection`: `cook.ingredientsHeader` (`## :salt: Ingredients`) + `cook.ingredients`
- `cook.cookwareSection`: `cook.cookwareHeader` (`## :cooking: Cookware`) + `cook.cookware`
- `cook.stepsSection`: `cook.stepsHeader` (`## :pencil: Instructions`) + `cook.steps`
- `cook.stepsWithQuotedCommentsSection`: Steps with block-quoted comments (`> ...`)
- `cook.stepsWithAdmonishedCommentsSection`: Steps with `!!! note` admonitions
- `cook.sourceSection`: `cook.sourceHeader` (`## :link: Source`) + `cook.source` (rendered when `.Metadata.source` is set)
- `cook.metadataSection`: `cook.metadataHeader` (`## Metadata`) + `cook.metadata`
- `cook.commentsSection`: `cook.commentsHeader` (`## Comments`) + `cook.comments`

### Registered Template Functions

| Function | Signature / Behavior |
|---|---|
| `getSource` | Wraps `http://` or `https://` URLs (without spaces) in `<...>` |
| `sumTimers` | Sums `Steps[].Timers[]` (`day`/`days`, `hour`/`hours`, `minute`/`minutes`); formats in `minutes`, `hours`, or `days` |
| `lower` | Converts string to lowercase |
| `replace` | `(old, new, input)` — replaces all occurrences of `old` with `new` in `input` |
| `round` | `(number, decimals)` — rounds float to `decimals` places |
| `add1` | Increments integer by `1` (used for 1-based step numbering) |
| `wrap` | `(limit, text)` — wraps lines at word boundaries to `limit` characters |
| `indent` | `(spaces, text)` — indents non-empty lines by `spaces` spaces |

Post-render normalization (`apply_markdown_format`) trims trailing spaces before `\n` and collapses 3+ consecutive newlines to at most 2.

---

## Recipe Data Model & JSON Output

Structs in `src/types.rs` serialize using PascalCase JSON keys (`serde(rename = "...")`) matching template field access:

- **`Recipe`**: `Steps: Vec<Step>`, `Metadata: HashMap<String, String>`, `Config: Config`, `Info: Info`
- **`Step`**: `Directions: String`, `Timers: Vec<Timer>`, `Ingredients: Vec<Ingredient>`, `Cookware: Vec<Cookware>`, `Comments: Vec<String>`
- **`Ingredient`**: `Name: String`, `Amount: IngredientAmount` (`IsNumeric`, `Quantity`, `QuantityRaw`, `Unit`)
- **`Cookware`**: `IsNumeric: bool`, `Name: String`, `Quantity: f64`, `QuantityRaw: String`
- **`Timer`**: `Name: String`, `Duration: f64`, `Unit: String`
- **`Info`**: `ImageFileName`, `ImageFilePath`, `NewRecipeFilePath`, `RecipeName`, `RecipeFilePath`
- **`Config`**: `DryRun`, `Jsonify`, `IgnoreFile`, `RecipeSearchRoot`, `LogLevel`, `TemplateFiles`, `WordWrap`, `OutputDir`

## Development, Testing & Quality Gates

### `Taskfile.yaml` Commands

```bash
task test         # cargo test
task fmt          # cargo fmt --all
task lint         # yamllint-rs . && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
task spellcheck   # typos
task dry-run      # cargo run -- --recipe-search-root testdata --dry-run
task debug        # Dry-run with testdata/recipe.md.gotmpl and --log-level debug
task jsonify      # cargo run -- --jsonify
task serve        # uv run zensical serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
task dist         # cargo build --release
task build-all    # Cross-compile Linux, macOS, and Windows release binaries
```

### CI Quality Gates (`.github/workflows/ci.yaml`)

- `cargo build --verbose --workspace` and `cargo test --verbose --workspace` across `stable`, `beta`, `nightly`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf`, and `arm-unknown-linux-gnueabihf` (via `cross`).
- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace`
- `yamllint-rs .`
- `typos` spellcheck
